Privacy.title: Privacy
Privacy.intro: Vernissage is a personal, non-commercial app for keeping track of the artworks you've seen. Here is what we do with your data.
Privacy.collect1: Your email address and name — to recognise your account. If you sign in with Google, we only receive your name, email address and profile picture; never your password or any other Google data.
Privacy.collect2: The artworks you mark as seen, together with the date, location, rating, notes and optional photo you enter yourself.
Privacy.collect3: Your votes for artists you'd like to see added to the app.
Privacy.use1: Only to make the app work: showing your own overview and tracking your progress.
Privacy.use2: If you enable “Seen items public”, other users only see how many people have seen a work — never who.
Privacy.use3: We do not sell or share your data with third parties and do not use it for advertising.
Privacy.storage: The database is hosted by Turso and the app by Vercel, under their standard security. Artwork images are loaded via Cloudflare R2 and an image proxy (wsrv.nl); no personal data is sent along with those requests.
Privacy.rights: You can change your name and privacy setting yourself on your profile page. To have your account and all associated data deleted, email <email></email> — we'll take care of it within 30 days.
Privacy.cookies: We only use functional cookies: a session cookie to keep you signed in and a cookie that remembers your language choice. No tracking, no analytics.
